adapted-matthew-5-31-32.title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 5:31-32
adapted-matthew-5-31-32.caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 5:31-32</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024), adapted. The ⓘ notes and any wording changes are additions, not from BibleProject; they are our opinions, not BibleProject's statements.
adapted-matthew-5-31-32.usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="31" /> It <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">has also been said</char>, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1">
        “Whoever <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">sends away his wife</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        he must give her a certificate of divorce.”
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="32" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">And I say to you that</char>
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        everyone who <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">sends away his wife</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        —<char style="bd">except on the ground of sexual immorality</char>—<note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-5-32-divorce"><char style="xt">Matthew 19:3–12</char></note> 
      </group>
      <group>
        he makes her a <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">victim of adultery</char>, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        and whoever marries a <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">sent-away-woman</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        he <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">commits adultery</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
